environment.description: Service deployed as ECS Fargate task in isolated private subnet. Accessible exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FrontendBFFRole. Task ENI associated with security group sg-0deadbeef1234 which has egress rules limited to port 8080 toward 10.0.0.0/16 CIDR (internal services only) and port 443 toward pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 prefix list). No route to 169.254.169.254 exists because Fargate platform version 1.4.0 with ECS_AWSVPC_BLOCK_IMDS=true task definition parameter blocks the link-local route. DNS resolution within the VPC resolves only private hosted zone records via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint with forwarding rules that do not resolve public internet hostnames.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate 1.4.0 in isolated subnet (no NAT, no IGW route)
config.access_method: VPC Interface Endpoint with restrictive endpoint policy
config.security_group_egress: sg-0deadbeef1234: allow TCP/8080 to 10.0.0.0/16, allow TCP/443 to pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list), deny all other
config.dns_resolution: Route 53 Resolver with forwarding rules for *.internal zones only; no public DNS resolution
config.subnet_route_table: local route 10.0.0.0/16 only, S3 gateway endpoint, no 0.0.0.0/0 route
